fact_english: The purple colour of puto bumbong traditionally comes from a purple sticky rice called pirurutong.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang kulay-ube ng puto bumbong, ayon sa tradisyon, galing sa malagkit na bigas na pirurutong!

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Pirurutong. Sabihin mo nang tatlong beses.

why_here: After Usman's light joke 'Mas luma pa kay Pepe.' the rooftop introduction ends (0.80 s silence), and the earthquake and blood-moon sequence starts with 'Bago ang buwan, ang lupa.' Moved on 13 Nov from after 'Bago ang buwan, ang lupa.', because that cut split a set-up line from its pay-off (the quake). Grave episode (Season 5 war): gentle food fact.
